business_summary: Focus Systems Corporation provides IT services for public and private clients in Japan. It operates through Public Related Business, Enterprise Business, Wide Area Solutions Business, and Innovative Business segments. The company also engages in the service of information security products; investment, development, and acting as intermediaries for companies and venture businesses; consulting and contract computer system development; systems operation and maintenance; development and distribution of information security technology and associated products, as well as software packages; planning and production of web content; temp staffing services; and other computer-related services. In addition, it is involved in the provision of technical support services for the realization of social infrastructure systems, such as my number-related, financial, trade, air traffic control, automobile-related, and insurance and pension systems; development of communication control systems, software for information and communication devices, and embedded software; infrastructure design and construction, mainframe operations, and related services; and IoT and information products and solutions. Further, the company provides core system, computerization/efficiency, IT infrastructure, cloud/virtualization, security, and built-in technologies; and cryptography, digital watermark, beacon/directional receivers, and workflow/electronic contracts. It serves the communication, finance, social security, aviation, automobile/transportation, trade/transportation, electronic administration, and local government fields. Focus Systems Corporation was incorporated in 1977 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Focus Systems Corporation은 일본의 공공 및 개인 고객에게 IT 서비스를 제공합니다. 공공 관련 사업, 기업 사업, 광역 솔루션 사업, 혁신 사업 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 회사는 또한 정보 보안 제품 서비스에도 종사하고 있습니다. 기업 및 벤처 기업에 대한 투자, 개발 및 중개 역할; 컨설팅 및 계약 컴퓨터 시스템 개발; 시스템 운영 및 유지 관리; 정보 보안 기술 및 관련 제품, 소프트웨어 패키지의 개발 및 배포; 웹 콘텐츠 기획 및 제작; 임시 직원 서비스; 및 기타 컴퓨터 관련 서비스. 또한, 마이넘버 관련, 금융, 무역, 항공교통관제, 자동차 관련, 보험 및 연금 시스템 등 사회 기반 시스템 구현을 위한 기술 지원 서비스 제공에 참여하고 있습니다. 통신제어시스템, 정보통신기기용 소프트웨어, 임베디드 소프트웨어 개발; 인프라 설계 및 구축, 메인프레임 운영 및 관련 서비스; IoT 및 정보 제품 및 솔루션. 푸르스
